meta.name: shipmap
meta.about: shipmap's own features, kept up to date as it's built. A sample with every status, the audit and the shortcut and config tables is at claptimes5.github.io/shipmap/example/.

flow.title: List features
flow.detail: One JSON file, one status each

features.name: init.mjs
features.says: Creates features.json from the example and offers to add the keep-it-true rules to AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. Safe to re-run; --yes skips the questions.

features.name: Agent setup prompt
features.says: A prompt to paste into a coding agent that installs shipmap and fills features.json from the project's real features.

features.name: Five statuses
features.says: Each feature is stable@version, main, experiment:flag, branch:name or review:#pr, as one string.

features.name: Shape errors fail the build
features.says: A bad id, unknown group or platform, bad status or missing date exits 1, so the map can gate CI.

features.name: Doc link check
features.says: Flags a docs link to a file or #heading that isn't in the repo.

features.name: Release drift check
features.says: Compares statuses with the newest git tag: stable versions that aren't released yet, and main entries that landed before the last release.

features.name: Staleness check
features.says: Flags experiments older than six weeks and pull requests open longer than 14 days.

features.name: One static HTML file
features.says: CSS inlined, no client JavaScript, noindex. Host it anywhere.

features.name: Status board and Needs a look
features.says: A column per status, stable grouped by release, with every audit finding listed underneath.

features.name: Shortcut and config tables
features.says: Collects every feature's shortcuts and config keys into two tables. Each only appears when some feature has one.

features.name: Light and dark theme
features.says: Follows the system's light or dark setting.

features.name: About line
features.says: An optional meta.about sentence under the title, to say what the map covers.
